This was a light, black transatmospheric '''ship''' that came to the aid of [[Pharika]] on [[Sakuub]] and was intent on taking the [[Sakuub Holocron]] after being led to it by [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]] and [[Jagged Fel]]. It killed Pharika after she was defeated but was then destroyed by an [[Unidentified Hutt (Sakuub)|Unidentified Hutt]] in his [[G1-M4-C Dunelizard fighter]]. Its occupants were unknown.

==Specifications==
The ship was described by Jagged Fel as compact and sleek, and completely unknown to anything he had ever seen before. The ship could also move with "astonishing speed" and was equipped with a [[Laser/Legends|Laser]] weapon. However, it was no match for the power of the Dunelizard's [[Laser cannon/Legends|Laser cannon]].
